correctness.rationale: The stationary Lyapunov matrix and conditional OU semigroup yield the quadratic Wick covariance. The forward Itô cross term is -2D*kappa*A*exp(-(kappa+1)*t); this nonzero term is included explicitly. The resulting two-exponential formula and its resonant kappa=1 limit give K(0+)=A^2*kappa*(d_c-d) and one exact positive root below the threshold, none above. Its positive-lag sign classification follows algebraically for every real admissible parameter, with the contact term 2DA delta_0 retained. The embedded standalone checker passed 1039 exact-rational and deterministic assertions including bivariate polynomial identities and resonant semigroup.

value.rationale: Lag-resolved fluctuations of active work diagnose injection/relaxation memory that cannot be inferred from integrated-work large-deviation rate functions alone. The full continuous-parameter thermal threshold, one zero-crossing regime, exact resonant time, and monotone stiffness boundary are natural and structurally motivated. The result correctly distinguishes the strictly positive zero-lag white-noise contact from a negative regular covariance for separated times, supplying a finite-bandwidth benchmark without demanding any speculative downstream theorem.
